## Activity

During February 2026, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 85 captures. This activity provides the basis for the site’s review of image quality and grading outcomes for the reporting period. The capture total is considered alongside the number of images that could not be assessed and the results that required referral.

## Image quality

Of the 85 captures, 8 were recorded as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 9.4%. These captures could not be used to produce a grading outcome. The ungradable results should remain under review as part of routine monitoring of image quality and service performance at Hill Counties Health Centre.

## Grading

Grading identified 21 referable results during February 2026. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. This indicates that the central grading process generally returned outcomes promptly during the reporting period. The referable total and the median lag should be considered with the activity and image-quality measures when reviewing operations at Hill Counties Health Centre.
